RecruiterSenior Technology Recruiter through Director · Read the full description
Overview

Vaco by Highspring is looking for an experienced Technology Recruiter to join our Northeast Technology & Digital practice.

This position is open to candidates at the senior individual-contributor level through Director. The final title will reflect the candidate’s recruiting experience, production history, technical-market knowledge, relationships, and ability to independently manage a technology recruiting desk.

You will join an experienced sales and recruiting team supporting clients across New Jersey, New York City, Connecticut, and Pennsylvania. The position will primarily support contract and contract-to-hire technology hiring, with opportunities to work on direct-hire, consulting, and project-based searches.

This is not a transactional resume-submission role. We are looking for someone who can develop meaningful relationships with technology professionals, understand the local talent market, build pipelines before demand develops, and serve as a trusted delivery partner to candidates, clients, and the internal sales team.

The work
  • Source, recruit, interview, and qualify technology professionals throughout the Northeast
  • Recruit across software engineering, data and AI, cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, enterprise applications, digital, product, and project delivery
  • Develop local candidate pipelines aligned with active searches and anticipated client demand
  • Conduct detailed technical, career, and behavioral interviews
  • Prepare accurate and compelling candidate summaries for client presentation
  • Manage candidates throughout the interview, offer, onboarding, and assignment lifecycle
  • Maintain relationships with placed consultants and identify extensions, conversions, referrals, and new opportunities
  • Partner closely with sales producers to understand clients, hiring managers, technical environments, projects, and search priorities
  • Share candidate-driven market intelligence, including hiring activity, leadership changes, emerging projects, compensation trends, and competitor involvement
  • Generate client introductions and sales leads through candidate relationships
  • Maintain complete and timely candidate, submission, activity, and placement records in Salesforce
  • Represent Vaco at relevant technology events, networking organizations, and local market activities
  • Build specialized candidate networks across high-demand technology disciplines
  • Independently own delivery for priority accounts and complex searches
What you bring
  • 3 or more years of agency technology recruiting experience, with greater experience expected at the Director level
  • Demonstrated success recruiting contract technology professionals
  • Strong sourcing capabilities across LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, referrals, internal databases, networking, and personal relationships
  • Working knowledge of applications, data, AI, cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, ERP, CRM, digital, and product roles
  • Ability to evaluate technical experience and conduct effective follow-up conversations
  • Experience managing multiple active searches and candidate processes simultaneously
  • Strong written communication and candidate-presentation skills
  • A relationship-focused approach combined with urgency, organization, and accountability
  • Familiarity with the New Jersey, New York City, or broader Northeast technology market
  • Experience using Salesforce, Bullhorn, or a comparable staffing ATS and CRM platform
Success
  • Consistent candidate interviews and qualified client submissions
  • Strong submission-to-interview and interview-to-placement ratios
  • Reliable delivery against priority job orders
  • High-quality candidate documentation and market intelligence
  • Regular candidate referrals, endorsements, introductions, and sales leads
  • Strong consultant retention and candidate experience
  • Increasing ownership of important skill areas, accounts, and talent communities
  • Positive collaboration with sales, recruiting, consulting, and operations partners
Individual-contributor scope

This is an individual-contributor position with no direct reports or formal people-management responsibilities.

At the Director level, increased scope may include:

  • Ownership of more complex, confidential, or high-priority searches
  • Responsibility for strategic accounts and specialized talent communities
  • More advanced production and delivery expectations
  • Direct partnership with senior sales producers and client stakeholders
  • Greater market visibility and involvement in important client pursuits

The Director title reflects recruiting experience, production, market expertise, account complexity, and individual impact rather than responsibility for managing other recruiters.

Growth and why join us

As the Northeast Technology & Digital practice grows, you can grow with it. Strong recruiters here can move into leading a recruiting pod, mentoring and building a team of recruiters, or running a practice in their specialty area.

We never force anyone into management. Stay a top producer or step into leadership; you decide how to scale your career, and we build that path with you.

Where this role can take you
  • Lead a recruiting pod and build your own team of recruiters
  • Run a practice: Perm Recruiting, Apps & Data, or Infrastructure & Security
  • Own delivery for priority accounts and specialized talent communities
  • Grow from Senior level to Director as your production and expertise grow
Why join us
  • Join an experienced recruiting and sales team with strong local relationships
  • Work within a Northeast practice that has grown consistently since 2019
  • Recruit across contract, contract-to-hire, direct hire, consulting, and project-based opportunities
  • Work remotely while remaining connected to a collaborative regional team
  • Operate in an environment where individual contributions and results are visible
  • Get in early on a practice that is scaling, with real room to grow into leadership
SalesSenior Client Solutions Manager through Director, Client Solutions · Read the full description
Overview

Vaco by Highspring is hiring an experienced technology staffing, consulting, or professional-services sales producer to expand our presence across New Jersey and New York City.

This position is open to candidates at the senior individual-contributor level through Director. The final title will reflect the candidate’s sales experience, production history, market relationships, account complexity, and ability to independently build and manage a territory.

This is a true business-development and client-growth role for someone who knows how to create opportunities, open new accounts, establish executive relationships, and turn an initial hiring need into a long-term partnership.

You will have the autonomy to build and manage your own market, supported by an experienced technology recruiting team and the broader capabilities of Highspring. You can lead with technology talent solutions and expand relationships through consulting, project delivery, managed services, and global delivery.

This is a builder role, not an account-maintenance position.

The work
  • Win new technology clients across New Jersey and New York City
  • Build relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, VPs of Engineering, technology directors, data leaders, product leaders, digital leaders, and other decision-makers
  • Develop a focused portfolio of high-potential SMB, mid-market, and selected enterprise accounts
  • Conduct consistent prospecting, cold outreach, client meetings, networking, and in-person market activity
  • Identify staffing, project, transformation, consulting, and managed-services opportunities
  • Sell contract staffing, contract-to-hire, direct hire, consulting, and managed-services solutions
  • Create account strategies and map the relevant buyers within target organizations
  • Grow accounts by developing relationships across departments, business units, and leadership levels
  • Partner with recruiting and delivery teams to scope searches, establish expectations, and provide an excellent client experience
  • Maintain an accurate pipeline, account strategy, activity history, and forecast in Salesforce
  • Use market intelligence, candidate insights, hiring trends, leadership changes, and business triggers to create relevant outreach
  • Expand successful talent relationships into consulting, project, and managed-services conversations
  • Coordinate recruiting, consulting, and delivery resources around client opportunities
  • Independently manage the complete business-development process from initial outreach through account expansion
What you bring
  • 5 or more years of successful technology staffing, consulting, or professional-services sales experience
  • Demonstrated experience winning net-new clients
  • Experience selling contract technology staffing or related professional services
  • A history of building and producing a meaningful book of business
  • Existing relationships with technology leaders in New Jersey, New York City, or the surrounding Northeast market
  • Experience selling to SMB and mid-market organizations
  • Strong prospecting discipline, including cold calling and self-generated client meetings
  • Ability to explain how you entered, developed, and expanded specific accounts
  • Experience building relationships beyond a single hiring manager
  • Executive presence without an overly corporate or transactional sales style
  • An entrepreneurial mindset and desire to own a market
  • Ability to work effectively with recruiters, consultants, practice leaders, and cross-functional partners
  • Experience using Salesforce or a comparable CRM platform
The right profile

This position is best suited for someone who:

  • Has personally opened accounts rather than primarily inheriting them
  • Is comfortable building relationships from scratch
  • Can demonstrate how cold outreach became meetings, job orders, placements, and revenue
  • Has a repeatable prospecting and account-development process
  • Understands the relationship between activity, pipeline creation, delivery, and gross margin
  • Wants autonomy, accountability, and uncapped earning potential
  • Can sell an initial staffing solution and identify opportunities for broader consulting or managed services
  • Wants to own a focused local market and build a durable book of business

This position is less aligned with someone whose experience has primarily involved:

  • Managing inherited enterprise accounts
  • Working exclusively through VMS or MSP programs
  • Receiving inbound requisitions without creating demand
  • Depending on national-account teams to create opportunities
  • Recruiting without meaningful new-business responsibility
Success
  • Consistent new client meetings and local market activity
  • New logos and reactivated accounts
  • Qualified job orders and consulting opportunities
  • Gross-margin growth across a focused account portfolio
  • Expansion from an initial contact into multiple buyers and services
  • Strong collaboration with recruiting and delivery partners
  • A repeatable pipeline with clear account-development priorities
  • Long-term ownership of an identifiable market
  • Increasing account value, earning potential, and market influence
Individual-contributor scope

This is an individual-contributor sales position with no direct reports or formal people-management responsibilities.

At the Director level, increased scope may include:

  • Building and managing a larger book of business
  • Developing more senior executive relationships
  • Leading complex client pursuits with multiple stakeholders
  • Expanding accounts across Talent Solutions, Consulting, and Managed Services
  • Managing larger pipeline, revenue, and gross-margin expectations
  • Owning more strategic or complex accounts
  • Coordinating cross-functional resources around larger opportunities

The Director title reflects production, market relationships, account complexity, strategic selling ability, and individual impact rather than responsibility for managing other producers.

Growth and why join us

As the practice grows, so can you. Build a bigger book as a senior producer, or move into sales leadership, territory leadership, or own one of the 6 markets in our region.

We never force anyone into management. Stay a top producer or step into leadership; you decide how to scale your career, and we build that path with you.

Why join us
  • Boutique feel with the backing and capabilities of a larger organization
  • An established recruiting team ready to deliver
  • A broad platform across Talent Solutions, Consulting, and Managed Services
  • Real autonomy over your territory, target accounts, and growth strategy
  • Competitive base compensation with uncapped commission
  • A remote-first environment built around trust, activity, and measurable results
  • The ability to build locally while accessing broader national and global resources
  • The option to pursue either continued individual-contributor growth or future leadership opportunities
Full-DeskSenior Full-Desk Technology Producer through Director · Read the full description
Overview

Vaco by Highspring is looking for an experienced full-desk technology staffing professional who can develop client relationships while continuing to recruit and deliver technology talent.

This position is open to candidates at the senior individual-contributor level through Director. The final title will reflect the candidate’s combined sales and recruiting experience, production history, local market relationships, and ability to independently build a profitable desk.

This role is designed for someone who does not want to choose between sales and recruiting. You will own the full lifecycle: identify target accounts, build client relationships, uncover hiring needs, recruit qualified technology professionals, manage interviews, close placements, and grow accounts after the first successful engagement.

You will join an established Northeast Technology & Digital team with experienced recruiting, sales, and operational support. The position offers the independence of building your own book with the advantage of a broader delivery and solutions platform behind you.

The work
Business Development
  • Build a focused portfolio of technology accounts across New Jersey or New York City
  • Prospect into technology leaders, hiring managers, and business executives
  • Generate client meetings and qualified opportunities through your own activity
  • Conduct discovery conversations to understand organizational priorities, projects, hiring plans, technical environments, and vendor relationships
  • Win contract, contract-to-hire, direct-hire, consulting, and project-based opportunities
  • Develop multiple relationships within each target account
  • Maintain a consistent outreach and follow-up cadence
  • Attend local client meetings, industry events, networking programs, and market activities
  • Develop account plans and identify opportunities beyond the initial hiring need
Recruiting and Delivery
  • Source and interview technology professionals across applications, data, AI, cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, ERP, CRM, product, and digital
  • Match candidates to active opportunities and longer-term client demand
  • Conduct detailed candidate interviews and qualification calls
  • Prepare candidate summaries and manage client submissions
  • Coordinate interviews, gather feedback, negotiate offers, and manage starts
  • Maintain relationships with placed consultants
  • Identify extension, conversion, referral, and additional hiring opportunities
  • Gather market intelligence and business-development leads through candidate conversations
  • Partner with specialized recruiters when additional sourcing or technical expertise is required
Account Ownership
  • Own the client and candidate experience from initial outreach through placement
  • Map hiring managers, technology leaders, and business stakeholders within target companies
  • Expand successful placements into additional job orders, departments, and service lines
  • Bring in specialized recruiters, consultants, and Highspring partners when deeper expertise is needed
  • Maintain accurate client, candidate, job, pipeline, and activity records in Salesforce
  • Monitor consultant performance, client satisfaction, assignment extensions, and conversion opportunities
  • Develop a focused, repeatable market rather than operating as a generalist without an account strategy
What you bring
  • 3 or more years of agency technology staffing experience, with greater experience expected at the Director level
  • Proven experience performing both recruiting and client-facing business-development activities
  • A successful record filling technology contract or direct-hire positions
  • Experience generating job orders, opening accounts, or expanding existing relationships
  • Strong sourcing, interviewing, candidate-management, and closing skills
  • Comfort initiating outreach to prospective clients and hiring managers
  • Ability to balance client development, recruiting delivery, and administrative responsibilities
  • Knowledge of the New Jersey, New York City, or broader Northeast technology market
  • A competitive, accountable, collaborative, and entrepreneurial working style
  • Experience using Salesforce, Bullhorn, or another staffing ATS and CRM platform
Preferred background
  • Experience across both contract and permanent technology staffing
  • Existing New Jersey or New York City client and candidate relationships
  • Experience selling directly to hiring managers rather than working exclusively through VMS programs
  • A history of opening or expanding technology accounts
  • Experience supporting financial services, healthcare, retail, consumer products, software, professional services, insurance, or life-sciences clients
  • Interest in building a long-term career as a high-performing individual contributor, with the option to pursue leadership as the practice grows
Success
  • A balanced pipeline of client meetings, job orders, candidate interviews, and submissions
  • Approximately 10 to 12 combined candidate interviews and client meetings per week as the desk develops
  • Approximately five qualified candidate submissions per week
  • One to two starts per month during the initial ramp, progressing toward approximately three starts per month
  • Steady gross-margin growth from year one into year two, with clear targets we set together
  • Consistent account expansion and repeat business
  • Strong candidate relationships and consultant retention
  • Increasing ownership of a concentrated group of local accounts
  • The ability to create business independently while using the broader team effectively
Individual-contributor scope

This is an individual-contributor position with no direct reports or formal people-management responsibilities.

At the Director level, increased scope may include:

  • Developing a larger and more profitable book of business
  • Managing more complex technology searches and client relationships
  • Building deeper networks of technology leaders, hiring managers, and candidates
  • Expanding accounts across multiple buyers, departments, and service lines
  • Combining client development and recruiting delivery at a consistently high level
  • Leading complex pursuits while coordinating internal subject-matter experts
  • Managing higher pipeline, activity, and gross-margin expectations
  • Owning strategic client and candidate relationships

The Director title reflects production, desk profitability, market expertise, account complexity, and individual impact rather than responsibility for managing other employees.

Growth and why join us

As the practice grows, so can you. Build a larger, more profitable desk, or move into territory or market leadership across the 6 markets in our region.

We never force anyone into management. Stay a top producer or step into leadership; you decide how to scale your career, and we build that path with you.

Why join us
  • Own the entire relationship rather than being limited to one side of the desk
  • Build a personal book of business with the support of an established team
  • Access contract, direct hire, consulting, managed services, and global-delivery capabilities
  • Work in a high-autonomy environment where individual performance is visible and rewarded
  • Receive competitive base compensation with uncapped commission opportunity
  • Work remotely while remaining active in the New Jersey or New York City market
  • Maintain the entrepreneurial feel of a specialized local team while accessing enterprise-level resources
  • Choose between continued growth as a senior individual contributor and potential future leadership opportunities
